seo.title: Ray-Ban: AI value-optimized Meta sales (Advantage+) - 2.08x incremental ROAS (2025)
seo.meta_description: Ray-Ban (EssilorLuxottica) tuned its Meta Advantage+ campaigns on purchase value plus a consideration objective: +32% average order value and 2.08x incremental ROAS in the United States.
seo.resume_citable: In 2025, Ray-Ban (EssilorLuxottica) achieved 2.08x incremental ROAS and +32% average order value in the United States by tuning its Meta Advantage+ campaigns on purchase value, combined with a consideration objective, measured by Conversion Lift.

faq.q: What is value optimization at Meta?
faq.a: A setting where the AI targets high-basket buyers rather than plain purchase volume, drawing on purchase value reported server-side.
Yes: the 2.08x ROAS and the 80% drop in cost per conversion are measured by a Conversion Lift with a search-lift method, not by attribution.

pattern: AI-automated sales campaign optimized on purchase value, combined with a consideration objective, measured incrementally

stack_technique.detail: AI-automated sales campaign: audience, placements, and budget managed by Meta.
Optimization setting where the AI targets high-basket buyers rather than gross purchase volume.
Server-side reporting of the purchase and its amount, a signal essential to value optimization.
Incremental measurement with a search-lift method, used to arbitrate between the three tested settings.

objectif_business: Increase the yield of sales campaigns by pushing the AI to seek high-value buyers rather than plain purchase volume.
description: Ray-Ban, the eyewear brand of EssilorLuxottica, tested how to better tune its Meta sales campaigns in the United States. The brand compared three approaches in an A/B/C on Advantage+ Sales campaigns: standard optimization, value optimization (where the AI targets high-basket buyers), and value optimization combined with a consideration objective. The test, from February 4 to March 22, 2025 on an adult audience, was measured by a Conversion Lift with a search-lift method. Value optimization alone brought 9 percent more ROAS and 32 percent more average order value. By adding the consideration objective, Ray-Ban achieved 2.08x incremental ROAS across all purchases, 2.1x on prescription lens purchases, and an 80 percent lower cost per incremental conversion on search visits.
points_cles: A/B/C test of settings on Meta Advantage+ sales campaigns.
Value optimization plus a consideration objective, measured by Conversion Lift.
Incremental ROAS of 2.08x and average order value up 32%.
Evidence B, status confirmed on standard Meta formats.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Continuous delivery; the optimization settings are compared in test waves with a control group.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: The brand's performance marketing team, on the Meta ad account.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The purchase value reported server-side (not just the purchase event). Without reliable value, value optimization has nothing to distinguish a large basket from a small one.

etapes.detail: The Pixel and Conversions API send not only the purchase but its amount, to feed value optimization.
The Advantage+ Sales campaign is tuned to target high-basket buyers rather than gross purchase volume.
Combining value optimization and a consideration objective dropped the cost per incremental conversion and doubled the incremental ROAS in the test.
The choice between the three settings was made on an A/B/C test and a Conversion Lift (search lift), not on the reported ROAS.

resultats.metrique: Incremental ROAS on all purchases (value + consideration)
Cost per incremental conversion, search visits

niveau_preuve.justification: Official Meta case study, quantified, backed by an A/B/C test and a Conversion Lift (search lift), with a named person; single source published by the platform.

statut_vivant.note: Ray-Ban (EssilorLuxottica) remains an active Meta advertiser; Advantage+ Sales Campaigns and value optimization are standard Meta features, which ensures the durability of the pattern.

prerequis_data: Purchase value reported server-side (amount, not just the event)
Sufficient purchase volume for value optimization and a Conversion Lift
prerequis_orga: Objective oriented to margin / basket rather than gross volume
Ability to read an A/B/C test and an incrementality study
stack_possible: Meta Advantage+ Sales Campaigns + value optimization + CAPI
Conversion Lift or geo-test as arbiter
replication.premiere_etape: Activate value optimization on an Advantage+ Sales campaign and compare it in an A/B to standard optimization, with purchase value reported via CAPI.

playbook.action: Make the Pixel and Conversions API reliable by reporting the purchase amount, not just the event.
playbook.livrable: Purchase events with value verified in Events Manager.

playbook.action: Set up the A/B (or A/B/C) test: standard optimization vs value optimization, possibly plus a consideration objective, on Advantage+ Sales.
playbook.livrable: Test structure with defined cells, budgets, and duration.

playbook.action: Deliver with an active Conversion Lift to measure incrementally, without reworking the campaigns during the test.
playbook.livrable: Campaigns in delivery with incremental measurement connected.

playbook.action: Read incremental ROAS, average order value, and cost per incremental conversion, then switch to the winning setting.
playbook.livrable: Documented decision and campaign in production on the chosen setting.

replication.equipe: 1 Meta media buyer + 1 dev / analyst for the Conversions API and the purchase-value reporting.
